mapper.sql: SELECT l.`id`, l.`type`, l.`detail`, l.`ip`, l.`created_at`, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`nickname`, ''), u.`username`, '管理员') AS `actor_name` FROM `note_admin_operation_log` l LEFT JOIN `note_user` u ON u.`id` = l.`admin_id`

sql.if: AND (l.`type` LIKE #{likePattern} OR l.`detail` LIKE #{likePattern} OR COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`nickname`, ''), u.`username`, #{actorFallback}) LIKE #{likePattern})

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `note_admin_operation_log` l LEFT JOIN `note_user` u ON u.`id` = l.`admin_id`
ORDER BY l.`created_at` DESC, l.`id` DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: SELECT l.`id`, l.`type`, l.`detail`, l.`ip`, l.`created_at`, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`nickname`, ''), u.`username`, '用户') AS `actor_name` FROM `note_user_operation_log` l LEFT JOIN `note_user` u ON u.`id` = l.`user_id`

sql.if: AND (l.`type` LIKE #{likePattern} OR l.`detail` LIKE #{likePattern} OR COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`nickname`, ''), u.`username`, #{actorFallback}) LIKE #{likePattern})

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `note_user_operation_log` l LEFT JOIN `note_user` u ON u.`id` = l.`user_id`
ORDER BY l.`created_at` DESC, l.`id` DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DATE(`created_at`) AS `day`, COUNT(*) AS `calls` FROM `note_ai_summary_record` WHERE `created_at` >= #{fromTime} GROUP BY DATE(`created_at`)

SELECT r.`user_id` AS `user_id`, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.`nickname`, ''), u.`username`, '未知用户') AS `name`, COUNT(*) AS `calls` FROM `note_ai_summary_record` r LEFT JOIN `note_user` u ON u.`id` = r.`user_id` GROUP BY r.`user_id`, u.`nickname`, u.`username` ORDER BY `calls` DESC, r.`user_id` ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `note_user`) AS `users`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `note` WHERE `deleted` = 0) AS `notes`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `note_ai_summary_record`) AS `ai_calls`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `note` WHERE `flagged` = 1 AND `deleted` = 0) AS `flagged_notes`
